recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five men framed within a black tombstone-shaped arch, set against a cream background. The portrait is obscured by atmospheric, colorful smoke or haze, creating a dreamlike, psychedelic effect typical of late 1960s rock aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: The black arch acts as a hard-edged container for the soft, hazy photographic content.
The cream negative space provides a stark contrast to the dense, colorful imagery inside the arch.
The primary text is centered at the top of the arch, following the curve's peak.
The smoke effect bridges the gap between the subjects and the foreground, creating depth.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five men in a staggered group arrangement, filling the lower two-thirds of the arched frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground and the bold white title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the white title, move down through the hazy faces, and settle on the colorful striped shirt of the rightmost figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial cream-colored border outside the arch provides breathing room and a vintage paper feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blues, greens, and browns within the photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the secondary subtitle and multi-colored stripes (teal, purple, yellow) on the rightmost figure's shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation within the photo due to the haze effect, contrasted against the flat, high-value cream border.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a long, elegant leg

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the dark background at the top of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the brand name paired with a functional, bold sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text at the very top peak

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, high-contrast serif look of the era.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the red subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a group portrait of five men in 1970s attire (paisley, stripes, denim). Apply a heavy atmospheric haze or smoke effect in teal and yellow tones. Frame the entire image within a black tombstone-shaped arch on a flat cream-colored background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a white, high-contrast serif font at the top center. Below it, add a secondary title in a bold red sans-serif font. Ensure all text is centered.

verificationChecks: Is the arch shape a perfect tombstone (flat bottom, straight sides, semi-circle top)?
Is the smoke effect obscuring parts of the subjects' faces and bodies?
Is the outer border a consistent cream color?
Is the primary text white and the secondary text red?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black arch border
Specific clothing patterns on the subjects
mustRedesign: Any specific band logos or trademarked symbols
The exact faces of the original individuals

avoid: Clean vector lines inside the photo
Glow effects that look like LED

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the arch border is solid black without gaps.
Verify the cream background is uniform and matte.
Confirm the smoke colors blend naturally with the photo's lighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tombstone Arch + Psychedelic Haze + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Cream Border
